item.title: Angel numbers 101: Your guide to spiritual alignment and growth
item.description: Angel numbers are believed to have different meanings, ranging from new beginnings and balance to protection, transformation, and abundance, and are seen as signs of divine communication and support.Angel numbers are believed to have different meanings, ranging from new beginnings and balance to protection, transformation, and abundance, and are seen as signs of divine communication and support.

item.title: A stuffed toy from IKEA is being listed for hundreds on eBay: Do you have one?
item.description: The plush toy has become one of IKEA’s hottest items after appearing in viral videos taken at the Ichikawa City Zoological and Botanical Gardens in Japan.

item.title: Aviation Institute of Maintenance readies students for aerospace jobs
item.description: The Aviation Institute of Maintenance in Phoenix offers a 21-month hands-on program that prepares students for high-paying careers in the aerospace industry, with graduates earning starting salaries of $70,000 to $80,000.

item.title: Be Our Guest: Caffe Boa
item.description: Caffe Boa Ahwatukee is offering 50% off dining as part of CW7's "Be Our Guest" series, and features large portion sizes of Italian comfort food, imported wines, and a patio capable of hosting parties for over 50 people.

item.title: Arizona's 100 Club raises funds for firefighter cancer prevention
item.description: The 100 Club of Arizona has launched a $700,000 fundraising campaign to provide cancer-prevention equipment for every fire truck in the state, which includes "storm sticks" designed to reduce carcinogen exposure for firefighters.

item.title: Heidi's Village enters 6th year of saving kittens in Arizona
item.description: Heidi's Village is entering their 6th year of rescuing kittens in Arizona, and is one of only a few places in the country with a neo-natal nursery for kittens, where staff members provide 24/7 care for 0-8 week old kittens.

item.title: Michael Jordan and Denny Hamlin's 23XI Racing aims for dominance
item.description: Any questions about how 23XI would emerge from December's federal antitrust lawsuit against NASCAR have been immediately silenced at the start of the new year.

item.title: Data centers' air pollution associated with lung issues: Report
item.description: Emissions from data centers can cause breathing issues and premature deaths for those living nearby, according to a new report.
